sections.heading: How ordering works
sections.text: Every handmade piece is made to order. Send a request and I will get back to you within 2–3 days to confirm details, price and delivery time. Payment is made once the order is confirmed.

sections.heading: Returns & refunds
sections.text: Since each piece is made especially for you, made-to-order items cannot be returned. If something is wrong with your piece, contact me within 14 days of delivery and we will sort it out. I do not accept returns if the item is not faulty or not as described.

sections.heading: Care
sections.text: To maintain the garment’s original shape, elasticity, and finish, machine wash cold (maximum 30°C) on a gentle cycle using a mild detergent. Turn the item inside out before washing, and strictly avoid chlorine bleach or fabric softeners, which permanently degrade the fibers. For optimal results, line dry or lay flat in the shade, keeping the fabric away from direct sunlight and tumble dryers. If necessary, iron only on the lowest heat setting using a protective pressing cloth.
